selection_reason: The Book-only completion census proved a parent-owned machine gap: qualified canonical state can select existing long-form objects but lacks one bounded registration/version/admission seam for new governing brief, canon manifest, story bible, book plan, manuscript, chapter and scene content. Phase 2 explicitly selected one non-duplicative Book-parent successor and kept Book Intelligence as proposal/orchestration input rather than a second canonical-write authority.
second_shift_rule: Unattended Book work may execute the State-024 content-admission successor only while delegation is revalidated against the live Book head. Completion must be followed by fresh owner-state evaluation and a next safe successor while shift time remains.
qualification_rule: This selector changes control routing only. It does not transfer qualification to changed software, create A-01 PASS, synthesize real author/publication evidence, grant Document/Prose/native authority, or establish production standing.
